notes: Top module sram_wrapper instantiates one hard macro (sky130_sram_1kbyte_1rw1r_32x256_8, blackboxed for synthesis via EXTRA_VERILOG_MODELS / MACROS config) plus an 8-bit free-running address counter and a 64-bit output register placed at the macro boundary. sequential_element_estimate = 8 (address counter) + 64 (dout0/dout1 registers) = 72 flip-flops in the wrapper's own std-cell logic; the macro's internal storage (256x32b) is not counted here since it's a blackboxed macro, not synthesized std-cell sequential logic.
